info.title: Libris automation API
info.summary: Send books to a Libris server and get them back translated, with no human step.
info.description:
Send an EPUB, TXT chapters or a JSON document to a Libris server, let it translate on its own, then
download the result with its completion report. Nothing needs a person along the way.

**Authentication.** Every call carries an API token: `Authorization: Bearer lbr_…`. Tokens are created
in the interface (**My account › API tokens**); each one carries scopes, named on every operation below.
The session cookie of the web interface never opens `/api/v1`.

**Asynchronous work.** A request is saved before the `202 Accepted` answer and runs in the worker.
Poll its status (`?wait=` long-polls up to 60 seconds by default) or receive a signed webhook when it
ends. A request always ends: `completed`, `completed_with_residuals`, `failed` or `cancelled`
(`imported` when it only imported chapters).

**Errors.** Every error is `{"detail": {"code", "message", …}}`. `code` is stable; `message` is in
French, or in English with `Accept-Language: en`. Validation errors never echo the submitted text.

**Limits.** Calls per token and per minute (`API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`, `429` with `Retry-After`), body
size (`API_MAX_PAYLOAD_MB`) and chapters per request (`API_MAX_CHAPTERS`) are set by the server's
administrator.

The full guide, with `curl` examples, is [docs/api.md](https://github.com/HeartBtz/Libris/blob/main/docs/api.md).

post.description:
Send **an EPUB** (multipart field `file`, or the raw file as `application/epub+zip` with its options in the query string), **TXT or DOCX chapters** (multipart, one or more `.txt` or `.docx` files in `file` or `files`, one chapter each, or one file split at its chapter headings with `split=headings`) or **a JSON document**. One request carries one kind of file.

The request is stored before the answer and its pipeline starts in the worker: `202 Accepted` with a `Location` header. The same content sent again with the same `Idempotency-Key` or `external_id` answers `200` with the original request and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Without the `pipeline:start` scope, send `start=false` to import only.

**Scope:** `content:write`, and `pipeline:start` to start the pipeline.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1–200 printable characters. Sending the same content again with the same key answers `200` with the original request; different content answers `409 idempotency_conflict`.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The file name, used to guess the volume number.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Your identifier of the request (same rules as in the JSON document).

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The series by name, created when missing (not with `series_id`). Required for TXT.

parameters.name: series_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). The series by id (not with `series`).

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Volume number, 1–10000. Required for TXT; for an EPUB in a series, taken from the file name when free, otherwise the next number.

parameters.name: volume_external_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Your identifier of the volume.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Volume title (an EPUB keeps its own otherwise).

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Author of the volume.

parameters.name: source_language
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). BCP 47 tag such as `en`, `fr-FR`, `zh-Hant`.

parameters.name: target_language
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). BCP 47 tag.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: context_backend
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

parameters.name: final_review
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Default format of the result; `epub` only for an EPUB (and its default).

parameters.name: callback_url
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

parameters.name: callback_events
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: replace_changed_chapters
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

parameters.name: discard_human
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`).

parameters.name: split
parameters.description: Raw EPUB body only (`Content-Type: application/epub+zip`). TXT or DOCX: `headings` splits one file holding many chapters at its chapter headings (numbers and titles from the headings, the split recorded in `report.decisions.intake`); `none` (default) keeps each file as one chapter. Refused for an EPUB.

schema.description: An EPUB (one file in `file`), TXT or DOCX chapters (one or more `.txt` or `.docx` files in `file` or `files`; `series` or `series_id`, `volume`, `source_language` and `target_language` required) or one `.json` document in `file` with no other field. Empty fields count as not given; unknown fields are refused.

file.description: The EPUB, the JSON document or a TXT or DOCX chapter.

files.description: TXT or DOCX chapters, one file each, numbered from their names.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the request (same rules as in the JSON document).

series.description: The series by name, created when missing (not with `series_id`). Required for TXT.

volume.description: Volume number, 1–10000. Required for TXT; for an EPUB in a series, taken from the file name when free, otherwise the next number.

title.description: Volume title (an EPUB keeps its own otherwise).

provider_id.description: Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

start.description: Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

final_review.description: Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

output_format.description: Default format of the result; `epub` only for an EPUB (and its default).

callback_url.description: Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

replace_changed_chapters.description: Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

discard_human.description: With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

split.description: TXT or DOCX: `headings` splits one file holding many chapters at its chapter headings (numbers and titles from the headings, the split recorded in `report.decisions.intake`); `none` (default) keeps each file as one chapter. Refused for an EPUB.

202.description: Accepted: the request is stored and will run in the worker.

200.description: Replayed: this content was already sent with this key or `external_id`.

get.description:
The chapters of the request in reading order (the whole book for an EPUB), as an EPUB (EPUB requests only), a JSON document, one UTF-8 text file, or a ZIP of one text file per chapter with a `manifest.json`. `?format=` wins, then the `Accept` header, then the request's own format.

Passages without a translation keep their source text. Before the end the answer is `409 result_not_ready` (with `Retry-After`), unless `partial=true`.

**Scope:** `results:read`.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request's `request_id`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Result format; wins over the `Accept` header. Default: the request's own format (EPUB for an EPUB).

parameters.name: partial
parameters.description: Return what is translated so far instead of `409 result_not_ready` (missing passages keep their source text; `X-Libris-Complete: false`).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Long poll: answer as soon as the request ends, or after this many seconds (bounded by the server's `API_RESULT_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS`, 60 by default).

200.description: The result. `X-Libris-Complete` tells whether every passage is translated. `application/epub+zip`: The translated EPUB (`format=epub`). `application/json`: The JSON document (`format=json`). `text/plain`: One UTF-8 text file, chapters under their headings (`format=txt`). `application/zip`: `chapters/001 - Title.txt`… and `manifest.json` with each file's SHA-256 (`format=txt-zip`).

401.description: A missing, unknown, revoked or expired token, or a disabled account (header `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). Codes: `missing_token`, `invalid_token`, `revoked_token`, `expired_token`, `inactive_account`, `unauthorized`.

**Scope:** `jobs:control`.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: `pause`, `resume` or `cancel`.

post.description: Sent by the worker to the request's `callback_url` when it ends. Check the signature over the raw body and refuse old timestamps. Any `2xx` counts as delivered; anything else is retried with an exponential backoff (30 s, 60 s… up to one hour) at most `API_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` times. Redirects are not followed.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Event
parameters.description: `translation_request.finished`.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Delivery
parameters.description: `<request id>:<attempt number>`.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds.

parameters.name: X-Libris-Signature
parameters.description: `sha256=<hex>`: HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>` with the token's webhook secret, or the server's `API_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

ChapterCounts.description: How many chapters the request created, found unchanged or replaced, and each chapter's progress.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the chapter: sending it again finds the same chapter.

number.description: Chapter number, 0–100000; decimals such as `12.5` allowed. Chapters are ordered by it.

title.description: Optional; without it the chapter is named by its number.

content.description: The chapter's text (not blank, at most `TEXT_CHAPTER_MAX_CHARS` characters).

flagged.description: Passages still flagged (`check`, `error`, `refused`) and not validated.

CompletionReport.description: What was translated, what kept its source and why, what it cost and how long it took.

reason.description: Why the request did not complete.

passages.description: Counts over the request's passages (the whole book for an EPUB).

residuals.description: At most 500; `residuals_truncated` tells when the list is cut.

autopilot.description: Decisions the autopilot logged for the job.

intake.description: Choices made when reading the upload (volume and chapter numbers, encoding, reused EPUB), each with its reason.

delivery.description: EPUB only: EPUBCheck `validation`, `repairs`, `inherited_errors`, and `errors` when the delivery failed.

Error.description: Every error of the automation API.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, French by default, English with `Accept-Language: en`.

request_id.description: The request that already used this key (`idempotency_conflict`).

reason.description: Why the request failed or was cancelled.

conflicts.description: Chapters already imported with another text (`chapter_conflict`).

protected_segments.description: Passages edited by a person that a replacement would drop.

strategy.description: Provider name and model (never its address or key), `quality`, `context_backend`, `final_review`.

start.description: Run the whole pipeline (needs the `pipeline:start` scope); false only imports.

provider_id.description: Provider to use; defaults to the volume's, then the series' provider.

final_review.description: Run the final review (never when the server disables it).

segments.description: Passages of the request's chapters (the whole book for an EPUB).

Provider.description: A provider a request may name: identity and model only, never an address or a key.

default_for_series.description: Your series that use this provider by default.

RequestDetail.description: The status document of a request.

job_id.description: The pipeline job; `null` while the request waits (`queued`).

stage.description: Current stage of the volume (`null` without a job).

step.description: Current step of the job, for example `translation`, `final_review`.

estimate.description: Remaining time and cost, once enough calls were observed.

error.description: Why the job stopped or failed; empty otherwise.

next_attempt.description: When a waiting job retries (Unix time, `0` when not waiting).

RequestStatus.description: `queued`: waiting for its volume. `imported`: chapters imported, nothing started (end state). `pending`/`running`: the job waits for a worker or works. `paused`, `waiting` (provider temporarily unavailable, retried), `blocked` (needs attention). `finalizing`: the result is being built. End states: `completed`, `completed_with_residuals` (some passages kept their source, listed in the report), `failed`, `cancelled`.

RequestSummary.description: A translation request, as answered when it is created.

job_id.description: The pipeline job; `null` while the request waits (`queued`).

Residual.description: A passage delivered in its source text.

reason.description: The autopilot's reason, the passage's last error, or `source_retained`, `untranslated`, `markup_mismatch`, `epubcheck_repair`.

translation.description: The chapter's text; missing passages keep their source text.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized source text (`null` when not recorded).

name.description: Found by name; created when missing unless `create_if_missing` is false.

create_if_missing.description: Create the series named by `name` when it does not exist.

StoredResult.description: The result file stored when the request ended successfully.

external_id.description: Your identifier of the request: a letter or digit, then letters, digits and `._:/-` (200 at most). Unique per owner: the same content sent again returns the original request.

volume.description: The volume: found by `external_id`, then by `number` in the series; otherwise created.

chapters.description: 1 to `API_MAX_CHAPTERS` chapters; numbers and `external_id`s must not repeat.

replace_changed_chapters.description: Replace chapters already imported with another text (otherwise `409 chapter_conflict`). Unchanged passages keep their translation.

discard_human.description: With `replace_changed_chapters`: allow dropping passages a person edited or validated (otherwise `409 conflict`).

callback_url.description: Webhook called when the request ends; its host must be allowed by an administrator.

TranslationPayload.description: A JSON translation request. Unknown fields are refused; nothing is ever downloaded from a URL it names.

Usage.description: Model calls of the request's job.

cost.description: Cost of the calls with a known price; `null` when none had one.

loc.description: Where the problem is, for example `["chapters", 0, "number"]`.

msg.description: What is wrong (the submitted value is never repeated).

title.description: Title of a new volume (default: “Series — number”).

WebhookEvent.description: Sent once when a request ends (any end state, `imported` included).

bearerToken.description: An API token created in the interface (My account › API tokens).
